mapper.insert: insert into user (openid, name, phone, sex, id_number, avatar, create_time) values (#{openid}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{sex}, #{idNumber}, #{avatar}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select date(create_time) as date, count(id) as cnt from user where create_time >= #{begin} and create_time <= #{end} group by date(create_time)
